text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On my way back from a day out with<n>Super Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We ended up walking quite a lot<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Still full of pep, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case... do you mind tagging<n>along with me for
just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's go and rest somewhere quiet...<n>What do you
say?
choice_data_list: How about we grab a cup of tea?
How about we grab a cup of tea?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I learned a reeeally<n>refreshing massage
technique<n>recently.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So I was thinking I'd give it a try on<n>you, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to be shy! Let's<n>go somewhere
you can lie down.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm all changed!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Creek. You're with your trainer,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, you're still training at<n>this hour?
Well, aren't you a<n>go-getter!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard though.<n>Taking the
time to rest is equally<n>important.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's what I was about to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I don't know if it's because<n>I exercised
differently than usual, but<n>my body feels a little
stiff...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hm? Let me take a look.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, help me out here, will you?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Upon Super Creek's request, I take a<n>look at Oguri
Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like there's anything<n>to be worried
about, but it might be<n>good to loosen up her
muscles a bit<n>with a massage.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look serious, but what do<n>you think,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: It might be good to loosen up those muscles.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well! Then it's my time to shine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You know how to give a massage?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The intricate stuff is best left to the<n>professionals,
but I can manage if<n>you're just looking to loosen
up a<n>little.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll squeeze the pressure points in<n>your feet too.
It's super effective,<n>even if it does hurt a lot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer. Could you wait here for<n>a bit?
choice_data_list:
Massages are best received after warming up your
body.

Massages are best received after warming up your
body.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer. Could you wait here for<n>a bit?
choice_data_list:
Massages are best received after warming up your
body.

Massages are best received after warming up your
body.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yep, I agree.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Oguri. First, let's hit to the<n>showers together!
♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Um... But I was going to train again<n>after a short
rest...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's enough for today. Be a darling<n>and come
along, why don't you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We'll be back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without getting a say on the matter,<n>Oguri Cap is
dragged off by Super<n>Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hear some strange noises coming<n>from the
showers shortly thereafter.<n>They vaguely sound
like screams,<n>but... I'm probably just imagining
things.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now then, Oguri. Lay down over there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll bear the pain if I have to. I just<n>hope there
won't be any lingering<n>discomfort.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! You'll feel all refreshed<n>once I'm done
with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mere seconds later, I hear Oguri Cap<n>shriek as she
gets her feet<n>massaged.
